nodes.description: Mapping address => Holder storing each user's unlockTime and balance; read/written by Put and Collect using msg.sender as key.
Log contract instance used by ALFA_bank to record Put and Collect events; set in the constructor from a user-supplied address.
Public uint threshold (1 ether) that a holder's balance must meet before Collect succeeds.
Per-holder timestamp enforced in Collect; derived from caller-supplied _unlockTime clamped with block.timestamp.
Per-holder ether balance increased in Put with msg.value and decreased in Collect with _am.
Array of Message structs appended to on every AddMessage call.
Temporary Message struct populated and then pushed into History by AddMessage.
Public payable function that credits msg.value to the caller's Holder and sets its unlockTime using block.timestamp.
Public payable withdrawal that checks MinSum, requested amount, timestamp and then sends ether via msg.sender.call.value(_am)().
Payable fallback that simply forwards to Put(0), extending the deposit path.
Constructor that stores the supplied address as the Log contract reference.
Public logging function that fills LastMsg and pushes it to History, timestamping with block.timestamp.
Caller-controlled address used as the key into the Acc mapping in Put and Collect.
Block timestamp (now) used to clamp unlockTime, to guard Collect and to timestamp log entries.
Low-level external call that forwards _am wei to the caller before the balance is decremented, enabling reentrancy.
State decrement executed after the external call and without overflow protection (Solidity 0.4 arithmetic).
Caller-supplied unlock timestamp accepted by Put and clamped against block.timestamp.
Caller-supplied amount to withdraw in Collect; also forwarded to the external call.
Constructor argument used to set the LogFile contract reference.
Sender address stored into LastMsg by Log.AddMessage.
Value stored into LastMsg.Val by Log.AddMessage.
String stored into LastMsg.Data by Log.AddMessage.
Local storage reference to Acc[msg.sender] inside Put.
Local storage reference to Acc[msg.sender] inside Collect.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used to index the Acc mapping inside Put, coupling state writes to attacker-controlled address.
Parameter _unlockTime flows into Put and is written to the holder record.
block.timestamp is compared with _unlockTime to clamp the stored unlock time, creating a timestamp dependency.
Put writes acc.unlockTime from a value derived from block.timestamp.
Put increases acc.balance by msg.value using unchecked arithmetic.
Local acc reference in Put aliases Acc[msg.sender].balance.
Local acc reference in Put aliases Acc[msg.sender].unlockTime.
msg.sender indexes Acc in Collect, allowing any caller to choose the holder record.
Parameter _am flows into Collect as the requested withdrawal amount.
The condition now>acc.unlockTime makes Collect's control flow depend on block.timestamp.
Collect reaches the low-level external call when balance, amount and timestamp checks pass.
The callee gains control during msg.sender.call and can reenter Collect before state is updated.
Collect decrements acc.balance by _am with unchecked arithmetic after the external call.
The balance decrement happens only after the external call returns, allowing repeated withdrawals.
Local acc reference in Collect aliases Acc[msg.sender].balance that is decremented.
Collect reads and writes the holder balance in Acc.
Collect records the withdrawal through LogFile.AddMessage.
Put records the deposit through LogFile.AddMessage.
The payable fallback transfers execution to Put(0).
Constructor parameter log determines the Log contract address stored in LogFile.
The constructor assigns the caller-supplied log address to the LogFile state variable.
Parameter _adr is stored in LastMsg.Sender by AddMessage.
Parameter _val is stored in LastMsg.Val by AddMessage.
Parameter _data is stored in LastMsg.Data by AddMessage.
AddMessage writes the message fields into the LastMsg struct.
AddMessage pushes LastMsg into the History array.
AddMessage sets LastMsg.Time from block.timestamp, making log data timestamp dependent.
MinSum is read in Collect's guard to decide whether a withdrawal is allowed.
